source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: When comparing how heavy or light objects are, decide which has more or less mass.
node_labels: Matter: materials, particles, mixtures and change

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: The heavier object has more volume.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: The heavier object has less mass, and the lighter object has more mass.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: The masses of a stone and a leaf cannot be compared because they are not in identical half-filled cups.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: The large foam block has more mass than the small stone because it is bigger.

intelligence.enrichment: How heavy or light an object is can be measured in terms of mass. The heavier object has more mass, and the lighter object has less mass. weighing or heaviness comparison -> relative mass comparison The learner correctly applies this rule: How heavy or light an object is can be measured in terms of mass. The heavier object has more mass, and the lighter object has less mass. Mass means the size of the container, so identical cups half-filled with different materials have the same mass.
